answers.p3: It exits with code 4 (unknown rule exits 4).
answers.p5: Each object has `path`, `line`, `rule`, and `severity` (no `message`), formatted by `mdcheck/formats.py`.
answers.p6: In the `RULES` registry in `mdcheck/rules.py`, in the order added (not alphabetical).
